[[Duck Hunt Event|Duck Hunt]] |first_wave_appearance = 16 ([[Duck Hunt Event|Duck Hunt]]) |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]50Beyond wave 20, '''Evil Ducky''' scaled its health with time. |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Above Average (3.5) |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Evil Ducky''' was an enemy that appeared exclusively in [[D00M's Revenge]] as part of the [[Duck Hunt Event]]. Currently, it can be spawned again in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. It had somewhat low health for its debut, but an above average speed. Beyond wave 20, its health would increase over time. ==Appearance== The '''Evil Ducky''' is a black duck with angry red eyes and an orange beak and feet. It also has red horns on its head. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[D00M's Revenge]] is listed instead. *The [[Minigunner]] and [[Accelerator]] can easily deal with the '''Evil Ducky'''. **You can also use the [[Commander]] to decrease their firerate. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseDREvilDucky.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (16 April – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} DuckHuntEvent.png|'''Evil Ducky''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} Ducks4.png|'''Evil Ducky''' on a promotional image. DuckHuntPI.png|'''Evil Ducky''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- Spring Trailer|'''Evil Ducky''' in a game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} LegacyEvilDuckyIconIG.png|'''Evil Ducky''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *This enemy looks very similar to the original [[Ducky D00M (Eggy Island)|Ducky D00M]]. *On the [[Duck Hunt Event]] thumbnail and promotional images, the '''Evil Ducky''' wields a trident, despite it never wielding a trident in-game. *Ducks similar to the '''Evil Ducky''' appear on multiple {{Color|Ducky|Ducky}} skins, such as the {{Color|Ducky|Ducky}} [[Mortar]] or {{Color|Ducky|Ducky}} [[Electroshocker]]. ==Update History == *'''17 April 2022''' - [[v1.2.0]] **'''Evil Ducky''' added. *'''28 May 2022''' - [[v1.2.4]] **'''Evil Ducky''' removed. *'''16 April 2025''' - [[v1.61.0]] **'''Evil Ducky''' can now be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, only when the player has the [[Evil Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Evil Ducky]]'s [[Logbooks|Logbook]] from the [[Ducky Revenge Event]]. ==Notes== {{D00MRevenge|[[Explosive Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Explosive Ducky]]|Wave 13|Evil Ducky|Wave 16|[[Long Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Long Ducky]]|Wave 17}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Evil Ducky}}
